**Group members**: Nicole Lewis (nel239), Rezwana Habib (rfh2133), Emanuel Clemente (ejc2222), Helene Apollon (hca2124), Meher Walia (mw3952)

**Anticipated Data Sources**: We plan to use publicly available datasets on New York City restaurants, including the NYC Happy Hour Index which contains information on happy hour specials, pricing, neighborhood, and borough, and a Google Maps restaurant dataset containing information on restaurant names, locations, ratings, number of reviews, and price categories. Both datasets are currently available in the project's data folder, and we plan to explore additional sources and supplement existing data with our own research as needed.
